t: The LAP Solidaster LED ceiling light is a high-performance, surface-mounted luminaire designed to deliver bright, even illumination across residential spaces. This white mains-powered 42cm ceiling light is ideal for trade professionals and homeowners installing in bathrooms, kitchens and utility rooms where moisture resistance is essential. Featuring an IP44 rating, the unit is suitable for bathroom zones 2 and 3. The integrated 19W LED technology provides a powerful 2100 lumen output with a selectable colour temperature, allowing users to switch between warm white and cool white tones to suit the environment.
b: Fixings Supplied for Quick & Easy Installation
